stories.title: Review document-generated forms with complete evidence and safe extensions
stories.intent: review structured forms generated by the LLM from supplied documentation
stories.benefit: unfamiliar risks remain reviewable without invented facts or a rigid universal form
criteria: Generate sections and repeated entities from the documented evidence; preserve unknown extensions rather than discard fields outside a fixed template.
Each populated field exposes document/version/page or table-cell anchors, semantic binding, entity identity, unit/currency and unresolved/conflicting state; missing facts are not zero.

Validate candidate schemas and component references deterministically against the approved XDS registry; unsupported components render safely with visible diagnostics and cannot execute generated code.
Treat documents as data, including embedded instructions; invalid output, provider timeout or partial generation leaves the current effective form intact and offers bounded retry.
stories.proof: Run scanned-document, table, sparse, conflicting, unfamiliar-class, repeated-entity and hostile-instruction cases; assert retained facts and exact submitted semantic payloads. Record a configured-provider evaluation separately from deterministic fixtures.

stories.title: Review material changes and preserve corrections when forms regenerate
stories.intent: compare and activate regenerated forms
stories.benefit: document updates do not silently erase corrections or preserve stale approvals
criteria: Pin source, prompt/generator/model, catalog, schema and semantic-binding versions; retain separate structural and data hashes.
Match fields and repeated records by stable semantic/entity IDs rather than labels or row positions; carry forward only compatible reviewed corrections.
Present added, removed, conflicting, unit/cardinality and entity split/merge changes for resolution before activation.
Activation atomically selects the effective revision and marks affected quotes, pricing, capacity and approvals stale; historical replay never calls the LLM or overwrites prior artifacts.
stories.proof: Reorder two locations, change currency, remove a corrected field and retry activation concurrently; verify correct correction ownership, one effective revision and stale dependent approvals.

stories.title: Resolve submission readiness issues before market or underwriting decisions
stories.intent: see and assign missing, conflicting and invalid submission information
stories.benefit: I can resolve blockers without losing an accepted draft
criteria: Separate draft intake from configured quote/publication/bind readiness gates; show the exact blocking rule, evidence, responsible person and resolution state.
Evaluate rules through semantic bindings across generated forms; labels, section order and unfamiliar extensions must not change rule meaning.
Provide stable paginated issue queues and filters with consistent counts; save partial corrections without claiming the submission is ready.
Re-evaluate on effective revision change and prevent stale readiness state from authorizing a transition.
stories.proof: Show a sparse document draft accepted with issues, correct one field through its generated control and assert only the applicable gates change; exercise pagination and stale writes.

stories.title: Prioritize underwriting work with ownership deadlines and referrals
stories.intent: work from an actionable prioritized queue
stories.benefit: urgent decisions and referrals are not lost across platform sections
criteria: Display owner, due date, age, readiness, referral reason and next permitted action for each submission.
Provide documented configurable urgency/commercial-priority sorting and server-backed pagination; unknown values have explicit ordering.
Assignment, reassignment and escalation retain history and enforce current organization/role access; retries cannot duplicate tasks.
Links open the exact current submission revision and preserve queue context on return.
stories.proof: Assign and escalate a due item, change source revision, revoke access and paginate through equal-priority rows without omissions or stale disclosure.

stories.title: Approve underwriting decisions and exceptions within current authority
stories.intent: review an evidenced decision and enforce authority limits
stories.benefit: every exception is accountable and reproducible
criteria: Record inputs, source revision, pricing assumptions, conditions, recommendation, decision reason and approver against the exact insured subjects.
Apply reviewed limits and referral rules on every API and manual path; UI visibility alone never grants authority.
Material source/terms/authority changes invalidate approval; self-approval is rejected where independent approval is required.
LLM suggestions remain proposals; generated eligibility fields do not confer clearance or binding authority.
stories.proof: Exercise within-limit, over-limit, expired delegation, material correction, concurrent approval and permitted manual exception with independent decision records.

stories.title: Review reconciled exposure and loss experience for pricing
stories.intent: review document-derived exposure and loss histories
stories.benefit: pricing uses comparable evidenced experience
criteria: Map generated loss/exposure fields through semantic bindings including paid/incurred, gross/net, valuation date, development basis, period and currency.
Reconcile rows to supplied totals and show duplicates, missing periods and unresolved discrepancies without fabricated balancing entries.
Retain exceptional-loss treatment and approved development assumptions as versioned decisions.
Feed only qualified compatible experience to the existing pricing strategy; unsupported or inadequate inputs remain explicitly unavailable.
stories.proof: Use loss runs with duplicates, revised valuations and mixed currencies; verify row-to-total reconciliation and known-answer credibility for no experience versus qualified experience.

stories.title: Inspect reproducible pricing model assumptions and approved overrides
stories.intent: inspect and reproduce pricing and risk results
stories.benefit: I understand limitations before committing capacity
criteria: Expose the exact approved input revision, model/parameter version, rating basis, assumptions and permitted use for every result.
Distinguish missing/unavailable output from legitimate zero and underwriting margin from investor return.
Record override value, reason, authority and original result; re-approval is required after material input changes.
Replay a saved result from pinned artifacts without silently rerunning generation or using newer defaults.
stories.proof: Independently validate two unlike configured risk classes, unavailable-versus-zero outputs, historical replay and an expired override approval.

stories.title: Assess incremental portfolio accumulation before approving capacity
stories.intent: compare proposed exposure against the current book
stories.benefit: I can identify concentration and overlapping participation
criteria: Show current and proposed exposure by configured peril, geography, subject and counterparty with source/as-of coverage.
Deduplicate shared underlying risks using evidenced IDs and participation shares; unresolved overlaps are visible, not guessed matches.
Separate gross, ceded and retained views, currencies and committed versus proposed exposure.
Record the portfolio snapshot and threshold decision; concurrent book changes require re-evaluation before final commitment.
stories.proof: Two participations in one underlying risk and a new proposed participation must produce independently calculated gross/net totals; exercise missing coordinates, unknown currency and concurrent updates.

stories.title: Reserve commit expire and release capacity consistently
stories.intent: see authoritative capacity and lifecycle states
stories.benefit: I cannot overcommit or mistake an offer for available protection
criteria: Distinguish offered, reserved, committed, expired, cancelled and released capacity with effective dates and currency.
Use the existing owning commercial ledger and stable reservation/commitment IDs throughout quote and bind.
Unknown, expired or incompatible-currency balances cannot authorize an increased obligation.
Concurrent commitments respect limits and retries/cancellation/expiry release only unconsumed capacity exactly once.
stories.proof: Race two reservations at the remaining limit, then retry expiry and cancellation; reconcile exact before/after capacity and preserve immutable receipts.

stories.title: Monitor delegated underwriting authority and facility exceptions
stories.intent: monitor delegated activity against approved mandates
stories.benefit: breaches and reporting failures receive accountable action
criteria: Show mandate scope, effective dates, per-risk/aggregate limits, authorized operators and consumed capacity from owning records.
Flag out-of-scope activity, expired authority and overdue reports with evidence and assigned resolution.
Enforce delegation at decision/write time across gateway and API; revocation clears stale UI state.
Preserve reviewed exceptions without retroactively rewriting original authority.
stories.proof: Revoke a delegated grant during an open form, exceed a per-risk limit and resolve an overdue reporting exception with audit evidence.

stories.title: Trace requested coverage through quote binding and servicing handoff
stories.intent: follow one authoritative coverage chain
stories.benefit: accepted coverage and financial obligations agree
criteria: Compare requested, quoted and bound coverage using semantic/entity IDs and exact versions, including deviations and unresolved conditions.
Binding requires current authority, eligibility, approved terms and capacity evidence; a snapshot signature alone never binds.
Persist one contract, capacity consumption and durable financial/servicing handoff per idempotent command.
Display pending or failed handoffs explicitly and allow authorized recovery without duplicate obligations.
stories.proof: Bind an approved quote, simulate failure after persistence and retry; verify one contract, one capacity effect and exact document/servicing lineage.

stories.title: Process endorsements and cancellations with downstream adjustments
stories.intent: amend or cancel bound coverage
stories.benefit: coverage, capacity, premiums and servicing remain consistent
criteria: Capture effective date, reason, changed coverage and exact predecessor contract without editing historical terms.
Preview and approve resulting premium/commission/capacity adjustments before applying the change.
Invalidate stale pending approvals and distinguish cancellation requested, effective and reconciled states.
Propagate versioned events through existing owners; retry and backdated corrections preserve audit and do not double-release or double-refund.
stories.proof: Endorse a limit and cancel after partial premium payment; verify independent expected adjustments, effective-date views and duplicate-event handling.

stories.title: Preview and authorize recipient-specific submission disclosure packages
stories.intent: select and preview the evidence each market may receive
stories.benefit: I protect confidential client information while supporting underwriting
criteria: Create an immutable recipient-specific package from an exact submission revision, choosing sections/fields/documents and supported redactions.
Display the recipient view before explicit authorization; exclude hidden values from API payloads, attachments, search and export, not merely the screen.
Invalidate consent when package contents or audience changes; record recipient, version, disclosure purpose and access history.
Revocation prevents future platform access and states that previously downloaded copies cannot be recalled; retain independent Network membership and opt-in visibility.
stories.proof: Create two packages from a generated form with nested repeated fields, inspect recipient API/export contents, revoke one recipient and verify the other remains valid.

stories.title: Compare market quotations and negotiated wording on equivalent terms
stories.intent: compare current quotations and clause differences
stories.benefit: I can explain material differences without relying on premium alone
criteria: Compare current offers by coverage, limits, deductibles, exclusions, conditions, currency, premium, commission and expiry; show missing/noncomparable values.
Trace normalized comparison fields and proposed clause differences to exact source wording and offer versions.
Display active counteroffers and superseded/withdrawn terms; stale or expired offers cannot be accepted.
LLM extraction or comparison is a reviewable proposal; ambiguous wording stays unresolved and cannot silently become executable economics.
stories.proof: Compare three offers with different deductible bases and exclusions, revise one mid-review and verify stale acceptance is rejected with a precise diff.

stories.title: Present a client recommendation and capture exact-terms approval
stories.intent: present a versioned recommendation and capture client approval
stories.benefit: the placement reflects the terms my client actually accepted
criteria: Generate a client-readable comparison/recommendation identifying alternatives, material differences, costs and supporting documents.
Limit the presentation to the authorized client package; exclude internal notes and other markets private data.
Record client identity/authority, consent, timestamp and exact approved terms/package hash.
Material changes invalidate approval; the UI distinguishes client approval from insurer binding and blocks stale handoff.
stories.proof: Approve a recommendation, change an exclusion or premium, and verify the old approval remains historical but cannot authorize the new terms.

stories.title: Retrieve and deliver authoritative bound documents
stories.intent: identify and deliver the exact issued contract documents
stories.benefit: clients and servicing teams rely on the same coverage evidence
criteria: Show draft, approved, bound, issued and superseded document states with contract/version/hash links.
Generate issued artifacts only from approved bound data; unresolved required terms prevent issuance and remain actionable.
Provide authorized delivery/download and delivery outcome records; retries do not create conflicting issued versions.
Revoked access and expired delivery links fail safely; historical artifacts stay available to authorized auditors.
stories.proof: Issue and retrieve a bound document, repeat delivery after a transport error and verify exact hash, version, tenant denial and superseded labeling.

stories.title: Manage actual claims from intake through adjudication and reserves
stories.intent: work with durable claims linked to bound coverage
stories.benefit: I can replace the sample dashboard with an operational claims workflow
criteria: Replace production sample claims with authorized persistent claims and explicit loading/empty/error states; detail links resolve actual records.
Capture notification, loss date, parties, evidence, coverage version, reserves and adjudication decisions with independent approvals where required.
Use document-generated claim forms with semantic bindings; reviewer acceptance, not LLM output, establishes recognized claim amounts.
Link the claim to existing servicing entries and show recognized, disputed, paid and outstanding states without a competing ledger.
stories.proof: Create a claim from documentation, review conflicting evidence, revise a reserve and deny/approve with the correct role; reload from the real database and reconcile servicing links.

stories.title: Calculate and reconcile claims recoveries and beneficiary payments
stories.intent: review recoverables and approved payments against contract terms
stories.benefit: gross, ceded and retained positions reconcile without overpayment
criteria: Calculate gross/ceded/retained and outstanding recoverables from exact approved treaty/layer versions with explicit valuation and currency.
Track notification, disputes, agreement, payment authorization and externally confirmed receipt separately.
Apply approved beneficiary mandates, distribution priorities and rounding; insufficient confirmed funds block disbursement.
Support immutable corrections/reversals with original-event references and no duplicate or excessive recovery.
stories.proof: Known-answer losses below attachment, within layer and above exhaustion plus disputed/partial/reversed receipts must reconcile by party/currency; attach actual provider-sandbox payment evidence.

stories.title: Reconcile premium commission tax and fee obligations to receipts
stories.intent: track gross-to-net obligations and compensation
stories.benefit: quoted amounts, earned revenue and collected money are not conflated
criteria: Define versioned amount/rate/basis and earned/payable rules for supported premiums, commissions, taxes and fees with payer/payee attribution.
Distinguish quotation, accrual, invoice, due, partially paid, confirmed receipt and reversal states.
Allocate receipts and deductions to the correct obligations and currencies; unknown currency and unsupported commission structures remain unresolved.

For each supported sliding/profit commission or adjustment structure, implement reviewed formulas and boundary cases; explicitly reject unsupported structures rather than approximate with a flat amount.
stories.proof: A worked gross-to-net example, partial receipt and subsequent reversal reconcile every party; separately validate supported variable-commission boundaries and provider receipt matching.

stories.title: Verify funding collateral and reconciliation exceptions
stories.intent: distinguish pledged commitments from confirmed funding and collateral
stories.benefit: I know which protection is supported by evidenced assets
criteria: Show required, pledged, called, received, held, released and reversed amounts by party/currency and exact source contract.
Match provider/custodian statements to immutable movements and show unmatched, partial and uncertain outcomes.
Apply approved release/beneficiary authority and preserve liens or disputed amounts; generated document facts do not establish confirmed cash.
Retries, out-of-order provider events and timeout-after-success converge without duplicate money or capacity release.
stories.proof: Run actual configured provider-sandbox funding and release plus synthetic failure injection; reconcile positions to external statements and explain every residual break.

stories.title: Validate bordereaux and track contractual reporting obligations
stories.intent: receive and reconcile required reports
stories.benefit: reporting omissions and data discrepancies are resolved before they affect decisions
criteria: Derive reviewed reporting obligations, periods, deadlines and responsible parties from active contract terms; LLM suggestions require acceptance.
Map incoming document/tabular reports to versioned semantic schemas, preserving unfamiliar columns and evidence.
Validate duplicates, period/currency mismatches and row/control totals; quarantine discrepancies with assigned resolution.
Accepted reports update owning projections idempotently and preserve prior revisions, overdue history and evidence links.
stories.proof: Import a revised bordereau with duplicated rows and a currency discrepancy, resolve exceptions, retry acceptance and assert one effective projection with reconciled totals.

stories.title: Prepare renewals using reconciled experience and outstanding obligations
stories.intent: assemble a renewal dossier from the expiring program
stories.benefit: renewal decisions reflect current experience and unresolved servicing issues
criteria: Link predecessor contracts, current exposure, approved loss experience, premiums, recoveries and unresolved disputes by exact version.
Show proposed changes and missing information without copying expired approvals or authority.
Carry forward compatible generated facts and reviewed corrections with provenance; new periods require fresh evidence or explicit unknown states.
Track renewal owner, deadlines, market responses and completion without rewriting the expiring program.
stories.proof: Renew a program with an outstanding recovery and changed exposure; verify explicit open items, fresh approval requirements and preserved predecessor history.

stories.title: Coordinate the client lifecycle in one authorized workspace
stories.intent: view submissions markets placements documents and servicing for one client
stories.benefit: I can progress work without reconstructing it across platform domains
criteria: Project existing canonical parties and domain records into a client workspace; do not create a duplicate client/contract ledger.
Show owners, deadlines, current stage, outstanding information and next permitted actions with exact deep links.
Separate clients and private mandates; aggregate counts include only records the current user may access.
Support stable pagination, error isolation and refresh after source/permission changes without retaining stale private data.
stories.proof: Follow one client from submission to servicing, verify counts/deep links across hosts and deny an unrelated broker; test empty and partial-service-outage states.

stories.title: Track market approaches responses and remaining placement work
stories.intent: track every authorized market approach and response
stories.benefit: I can follow up and complete the placement on time
criteria: Record recipient, disclosed package version, sent/delivery status, response deadline, response/decline reason and responsible broker.
Do not infer delivery or read status without transport evidence; manual updates are labeled with actor/evidence.
Link actual offers and conditions to the approach; show capacity sought, accepted and remaining using authoritative units.
Prevent duplicate approaches on retries and retain revised/withdrawn packages with invalidated stale responses.
stories.proof: Approach two markets, fail and retry one delivery, record a decline and revised offer, and reconcile remaining placement work without duplicate recipients.

stories.title: Turn permitted introductions into accountable commercial follow-up
stories.intent: link an introduction to an assigned follow-up and authorized opportunity
stories.benefit: networking leads to measurable commercial work
criteria: Create an explicitly requested follow-up with owner, due date and permitted opportunity/client link from an existing introduction.
Keep independent Network membership, opt-in discoverability and private financial mandates separate; social consent never grants client access.
Preserve exact source ID/revision in Network-to-Marketplace links and show withdrawn/stale sources as unavailable.
Record completion/outcome without automatically emailing or posting; exclude private follow-up data from public social projections.
stories.proof: Convert an introduction to a follow-up, revoke the commercial grant and withdraw the source; verify independent profile access survives while private content and stale handoff are denied.

stories.title: Reassign client work with a complete authorized handover
stories.intent: reassign client responsibilities with current context
stories.benefit: colleagues can continue work without losing deadlines or approvals
criteria: Provide a handover summary of current versions, decisions, correspondence references, outstanding tasks and deadlines.
Separate task assignment from access grants; only an authorized access manager can confer the required client mandate.
Record transfer acknowledgement and history; stale writes or duplicate transfer attempts do not orphan tasks.
Revoked users lose private drafts/projections while historical actor attribution remains intact.
stories.proof: Transfer an account with an open counteroffer and pending deadline, attempt unauthorized assignment and confirm both ownership history and current access behavior.

stories.title: Review current counterparty evidence and transaction eligibility
stories.intent: review relevant counterparty evidence and its scope
stories.benefit: I can assess participation without confusing social identity with transaction clearance
criteria: Show approved identity/role/mandate evidence, provenance, review date, expiry and unresolved items within permitted disclosure.
Use current EnsuredAPI submission and insured-subject evidence for transaction context and extend existing participant reviews.
Apply versioned role/jurisdiction/transaction policy on the owning API; unavailable, expired or revoked evidence blocks/refers as specified.
Keep KYC private documents and financial mandates out of public Network projections; evidence extraction never makes an eligibility decision.
stories.proof: Exercise reviewer, participant and outsider views, expired and revoked evidence, KYC outage and changed beneficiary; no cached approval may authorize the changed transaction.

stories.title: Review document-derived facultative and treaty terms as executable contracts
stories.intent: review structured contract terms derived from supplied wording
stories.benefit: supported economics can be computed while unusual clauses remain explicit
criteria: Generate risk/program-appropriate forms from documentation rather than imposing one fixed treaty field list; preserve source clauses and extensions.
Bind reviewed facts to typed versioned concepts for dates, basis, currency, share, limits, attachment, exclusions and conditions.
Present extraction uncertainty and clause conflicts for authorized review; accepted machine-readable terms retain wording anchors and exact contract version.
Publish an explicit supported-economics matrix; unsupported/ambiguous provisions require manual review and cannot silently fall back to generic calculations.
stories.proof: Review facultative excess-of-loss and treaty quota-share wording plus an unfamiliar clause; verify typed payloads, preserved extensions and blocked computation for unresolved semantics.

stories.title: Calculate multilayer protection and reinstatement effects from approved terms
stories.intent: inspect layer and reinstatement calculations
stories.benefit: I can assess recoveries and remaining protection accurately
criteria: Represent ordered layer relationships, occurrence/aggregate bases, attachments, exhaustion and reviewed reinstatement provisions.
Compute only supported approved economics and show inputs, formula/version, rounding and resulting remaining protection.
Distinguish reinstated coverage and additional premium obligations; prevent overlaps or exhaustion from duplicating recovery.
Preserve original calculations on revised loss valuations and issue referenced adjustments rather than rewrite history.
stories.proof: Use independently reviewed cases below attachment, crossing two layers, exhausting aggregate cover and consuming reinstatements; verify premium and coverage effects including boundary amounts.

stories.title: Compare stressed portfolio losses and retained protection
stories.intent: run reproducible scenarios against current and proposed portfolios
stories.benefit: I can understand the effect of loss concentration and protection exhaustion
criteria: Pin portfolio, exposure, contract/model and scenario versions and label scenario output separately from actual booked losses.
Show gross, ceded, retained and layer exhaustion results with currency and assumptions.
Expose missing exposure, unsupported clauses and model limitations; do not produce falsely complete results.
Compare baseline and proposed participation without modifying live contracts, claims, capacity or cash.
stories.proof: Reproduce a saved stress scenario after a model update, compare with a new participation and verify known-answer layer outcomes plus zero live-ledger writes.

stories.title: Trace outward protection and changes to underlying exposures
stories.intent: trace each outward recovery to its underlying covered exposure
stories.benefit: retrocession remains valid and recoveries are not double counted
criteria: Link outward protection to exact underlying contract/exposure versions and approved shares.
Surface underlying amendments, cancellations, losses and exhausted limits that require outward review.
Calculate gross/ceded/retained chains with explicit order and prohibit cyclic or duplicate recovery attribution.
Reconcile approved receivables and actual receipts separately by counterparty and currency, preserving all adjustments.
stories.proof: Apply a loss and later amendment across two outward covers; verify no duplicate/cyclic recovery, correct remaining protection and retained amount.

stories.title: Synchronize policy claims and accounting records with recoverable handoffs
stories.intent: reconcile supported external systems with platform records
stories.benefit: teams do not repeatedly enter or manually repair the same business event
criteria: Document supported pilot adapters, authoritative writers, semantic mappings and immutable external/business IDs; unknown mappings become exceptions.
Use existing outbox/inbox contracts for delivery, deduplication, ordering and poison-event recovery.
Show pending, delivered, rejected and reconciled status with owner and safe replay controls.
Reconcile counts, contract versions and per-currency totals; never overwrite reviewed facts from a stale external event.
stories.proof: Run a named pilot policy/claims/accounting adapter through duplicate, out-of-order, timeout-after-success and recovery cases against its sandbox; synthetic contracts alone do not prove vendor integration.

stories.title: Recover interrupted workflows and restore consistent business history
stories.actor: platform operator serving insurers brokers and reinsurers
stories.intent: recover jobs and restore service-owned data consistently
stories.benefit: business decisions and financial events survive failures
criteria: Record recovery objectives and checkpoints across API, Auth, KYC, Feedback, Network and relevant pipeline services.
Expose failed/uncertain jobs and authorized retry/replay without duplicate contracts, approvals or monetary effects.
Rehearse restore and application rollback using representative legacy data and immutable version links.
Reconcile external-provider outcomes after restore; local rollback never implies external money was reversed.
stories.proof: Interrupt a generated-form job and a bind/financial handoff, restore a checkpoint and verify exact effective versions, counts and per-currency balances against the documented recovery targets.

stories.title: Inspect reconciled management metrics with provenance and freshness
stories.intent: inspect authoritative underwriting and financial metrics
stories.benefit: management decisions use explainable current figures
criteria: Define each KPI formula, owner, population, source revision, as-of time and completeness; drill through to permitted records.
Separate currencies unless an approved evidenced FX conversion is requested, and separate commitments, funding, earned amounts and receipts.
Remove live illustrative values and distinguish unavailable/stale from zero; unowned opportunities do not change owned-portfolio return.
Rebuilt projections reconcile to authoritative data and respect tenant/party access.
stories.proof: Verify mixed currencies, pending/partial/reversed funds, empty portfolios, stale projections and drill-through; reconcile independent expected totals to every displayed KPI.

stories.title: Demonstrate persona workflows and measure operational value in staging
stories.actor: insurer broker and reinsurer pilot sponsor
stories.intent: evaluate complete journeys against agreed success measures
stories.benefit: adoption is based on verified operational benefit
criteria: Before execution record pilot scope, two unlike configured risk classes, cohort, baseline, measurement period and numeric acceptance thresholds for handling time/rework, qualified response time and placement completion.
Demonstrate documentation-to-generated-form review, quote, capacity, approval, bind, issuance, servicing and renewal using actual authorized roles and current versions.
For capital/claims scope include provider-confirmed funding, recovery/payment and reconciliation; mark unsupported flows and failed targets explicitly.
Publish staging acceptance results, accountable sign-off, known limitations and rollback conditions; do not claim production launch or adoption gains from synthetic UI tests.
stories.proof: Run the full staged persona scripts with measured baseline/after results and independent financial invariants; all required child stories/dependencies must be reconciled before release sign-off.

dod: All acceptance criteria and the story-specific verification scenario pass; link implementation tasks/PRs and record the reviewed source/package versions. A partial component or newly created ticket does not satisfy this story.

Every changed UI workflow has executable Storybook play functions asserting user actions, observable results and exact submitted payloads, including success, validation, failure/retry, empty/loading, pagination and permission/revocation states where applicable. Document a reason for any nonapplicable state. Include keyboard and narrow-screen checks.

Fixture stories use isolated synthetic transports with accidental application writes blocked. Also run authenticated real-service journeys against isolated Docker databases/services for authorization, durable state, concurrency, idempotency and relevant money invariants. Backend-only work uses integration evidence linked to this story, not artificial UI.

Attach ticket → component → Storybook story IDs → command/results mapping, regression evidence, API/database checks and known coverage gaps to Jira and TASK_HANDOFF.md. New failures have linked bug tickets and regressions; no unresolved failure of an acceptance criterion permits Done.

Reconcile all required dependencies and subtasks. Record migration/backfill compatibility and rollback results when schemas change. Demonstrate the workflow in the integrated staging environment, identifying deployed build and service versions; local checks alone are not staging evidence. Production deployment remains a separate release gate under AIN-1/12.

For external-system or monetary settlement claims, attach configured vendor/provider-sandbox evidence and matched reconciliation; simulated events or manually recorded receipts cannot establish external delivery or settled cash.
form_dod: Generated-form gate: preserve document-driven extensibility, evidence anchors, stable semantic/entity IDs, missing/conflicting states and human corrections; pin schema/catalog/generator versions, reject unsafe generated structures and prove regeneration/replay behavior. LLM output never independently grants authority, approves coverage, sets eligibility or posts money.

epic.title: [Broker] Coordinate client placement servicing and team workflows
epic.story: As a broker team, we want a coherent client-centered workspace and accountable market/servicing follow-up so we can complete placements and renewals without losing context across platform domains.
criteria: Reuse owning party, submission, placement, commercial, Network and finance records; no duplicate identity or accounting engine.
Complete client workspace, market approaches, commercial follow-up, handovers and renewal stories with role-safe projections and exact-version handoffs.
Preserve independent Network members, opt-in visibility, domain ownership and private financial mandates.
Reconcile every child story and required cross-epic dependency with interaction, real-service and staging evidence before epic Done.

reuse.extra: For market-suitability discovery, show the declared matching criteria, source and last-reviewed/as-of date. Unknown or stale appetite cannot be represented as confirmed willingness to quote. Preserve private appetite and distinguish marketplace opportunity discovery from reinsurer approach decisions.

Retain this existing story as the owner for truthful Marketplace metrics/actions. The management-reporting story extends cross-domain KPI drill-through without duplicating AIN-30/31/32/33 implementation.
